column1: R001 - Verify Cloud Access Permissions and MFA Controls
column26:
Risk ID: R001

Business Area: IT & Cloud Infrastructure

Asset: Cloud Document Storage



Objective:

Verify cloud access permissions and MFA controls to assess potential unauthorized access risks.



Activities:

# Request the current list of authorized users.

# Review assigned access privileges.

# Verify MFA configuration and coverage.

# Check the date of the latest access review.

# Document findings and identify potential control gaps.



Acceptance Criteria:

* Access permissions have been reviewed.

* MFA configuration and coverage have been assessed.

* Findings and evidence gaps have been documented.

* Risk Register R001 has been updated.



Note: Independent GRC portfolio simulation. No real company data is used.
